run_llama_finetuning: run a finetuning job on a LLaMA model with FSDP, PEFT, and quantization options via fire CLI
run_mllama_vision_finetuning: run a finetuning job on an Mllama vision-language model with FSDP and layer freezing support
setup_wandb_tracking: setup a wandb run to track training metrics and config for a LLaMA finetuning job
run_peft_finetuning: run a PEFT LoRA finetuning job on a pretrained LLaMA model with 4bit quantization
run_fsdp_hybrid_sharding: run a distributed finetuning job using FSDP hybrid sharding with activation checkpointing enabled
